-- 20261015000200_rls.sql
-- ============================================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- RLS, grants and access helpers
-- Rule of thumb: the catalogue is public, everything transactional is own-row,
-- the stock vault and supplier config are service-role only.
-- ============================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Helpers. security definer + stable so they can be used inside policies.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.current_role_is(target public.app_role[])
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = (select auth.uid())
      and p.role = any (target)
      and p.is_blocked = false
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.is_staff()
returns boolean
language sql stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$ select public.current_role_is(array['staff','admin']::public.app_role[]); $$;

create or replace function public.is_admin()
returns boolean
language sql stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$ select public.current_role_is(array['admin']::public.app_role[]); $$;

revoke all on function public.current_role_is(public.app_role[]) from public;
grant execute on function public.current_role_is(public.app_role[]) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.is_staff() to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.is_admin() to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Enable RLS everywhere in public
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
declare t record;
begin
  for t in
    select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname = 'public'
  loop
    execute format('alter table public.%I enable row level security', t.tablename);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Default privileges: anon/authenticated get nothing unless granted below.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
revoke all on all tables in schema public from anon, authenticated;
revoke all on all sequences in schema public from anon, authenticated;
revoke all on schema private from anon, authenticated;
revoke all on all tables in schema private from anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- profiles
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select on public.profiles to authenticated;
-- Column-level: a customer may edit these three columns, nothing else.
grant update (display_name, phone, locale) on public.profiles to authenticated;

create policy profiles_select_own on public.profiles
  for select to authenticated
  using ((select auth.uid()) = id);

create policy profiles_update_own on public.profiles
  for update to authenticated
  using ((select auth.uid()) = id)
  with check ((select auth.uid()) = id);

create policy profiles_admin_all on public.profiles
  for all to authenticated
  using (public.is_admin())
  with check (public.is_admin());

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- settings: locked. Storefront reads public_settings instead.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create policy settings_admin_all on public.settings
  for all to authenticated
  using (public.is_admin())
  with check (public.is_admin());

grant select on public.public_settings to anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.profile_names to anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.variant_stock to anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Catalogue
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select on public.categories to anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.products to anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.product_variants to anon, authenticated;

create policy categories_public_read on public.categories
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (is_active = true);

create policy products_public_read on public.products
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (is_active = true);

create policy variants_public_read on public.product_variants
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (is_active = true);

create policy categories_admin_all on public.categories
  for all to authenticated using (public.is_staff()) with check (public.is_staff());
create policy products_admin_all on public.products
  for all to authenticated using (public.is_staff()) with check (public.is_staff());
create policy variants_admin_all on public.product_variants
  for all to authenticated using (public.is_staff()) with check (public.is_staff());

-- Sequences for staff inserts
grant usage, select on all sequences in schema public to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Orders / items / payments: own row only, writes go through RPC
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
grant select on public.orders to authenticated;
grant select on public.order_items to authenticated;
grant select on public.payments to authenticated;
grant select on public.wallet_transactions to authenticated;
grant select on public.reviews to anon, authenticated;
-- The insert policy below is useless without the matching table grant.
grant insert on public.reviews to authenticated;

create policy orders_select_own on public.orders
  for select to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid()) or public.is_staff());

create policy order_items_select_own on public.order_items
  for select to authenticated
  using (
    public.is_staff()
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.orders o
      where o.id = order_items.order_id and o.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    )
  );

create policy payments_select_own on public.payments
  for select to authenticated
  using (
    public.is_staff()
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.orders o
      where o.id = payments.order_id and o.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    )
  );

create policy wallet_tx_select_own on public.wallet_transactions
  for select to authenticated
  using (user_id = (select auth.uid()) or public.is_staff());

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Reviews: public read of approved ones, write only for a real purchase
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create policy reviews_public_read on public.reviews
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (is_approved = true or user_id = (select auth.uid()));

create policy reviews_insert_own on public.reviews
  for insert to authenticated
  with check (
    user_id = (select auth.uid())
    and is_approved = false
    and coin_rewarded = false
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.orders o
      join public.order_items oi on oi.order_id = o.id
      join public.product_variants v on v.id = oi.variant_id
      where o.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        and o.status = 'delivered'
        and v.product_id = reviews.product_id
    )
  );

create policy reviews_staff_all on public.reviews
  for all to authenticated using (public.is_staff()) with check (public.is_staff());

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Coupons: never listable, validated through an RPC
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create policy coupons_staff_all on public.coupons
  for all to authenticated using (public.is_staff()) with check (public.is_staff());
create policy coupon_redemptions_staff_all on public.coupon_redemptions
  for all to authenticated using (public.is_staff()) with check (public.is_staff());

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Suppliers + audit: staff only, secrets stay in private schema
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create policy suppliers_staff_all on public.suppliers
  for all to authenticated using (public.is_staff()) with check (public.is_staff());
create policy supplier_skus_staff_all on public.supplier_skus
  for all to authenticated using (public.is_staff()) with check (public.is_staff());
create policy audit_staff_read on public.audit_log
  for select to authenticated using (public.is_staff());


-- ============================================================================
-- 20261015000300_rpc.sql
-- ============================================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- Business logic. Everything the client can do goes through these functions;
-- tables stay read-only for customers. All money and stock maths is server-side.
-- ============================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Encryption helpers for the stock vault
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function private.stock_key()
returns text
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$ select value from private.secrets where name = 'stock_key'; $$;

create or replace function private.encrypt_payload(p_plain text)
returns bytea
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select extensions.pgp_sym_encrypt(p_plain, private.stock_key(), 'cipher-algo=aes256');
$$;

create or replace function private.decrypt_payload(p_enc bytea)
returns text
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select extensions.pgp_sym_decrypt(p_enc, private.stock_key());
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Order numbers
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function private.new_order_no()
returns text
language plpgsql
volatile
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v text;
begin
  loop
    v := 'YP' || to_char(now() at time zone 'UTC', 'YYMMDD')
             || upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 6));
    exit when not exists (select 1 from public.orders o where o.order_no = v);
  end loop;
  return v;
end;
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Wallet ledger. Row-locks the profile so concurrent debits cannot oversell.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function private.credit_wallet(
  p_user_id  uuid,
  p_amount   numeric,
  p_kind     public.wallet_kind,
  p_order_id uuid default null,
  p_note     text default null
)
returns numeric
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_balance numeric(12, 2);
begin
  update public.profiles
     set wallet_balance = wallet_balance + p_amount
   where id = p_user_id
  returning wallet_balance into v_balance;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'profile_not_found';
  end if;

  insert into public.wallet_transactions (user_id, kind, amount_usd, balance_after, order_id, note)
  values (p_user_id, p_kind, p_amount, v_balance, p_order_id, p_note);

  return v_balance;
end;
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Coupon validation (read-only preview + authoritative use inside create_order)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function private.coupon_discount(
  p_code     text,
  p_user_id  uuid,
  p_subtotal numeric
)
returns numeric
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare c public.coupons;
begin
  if p_code is null or btrim(p_code) = '' then
    return 0;
  end if;

  select * into c from public.coupons
   where upper(code) = upper(btrim(p_code))
     and is_active
     and starts_at <= now()
     and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now());

  if not found then
    raise exception 'coupon_invalid';
  end if;

  if c.max_uses is not null and c.used_count >= c.max_uses then
    raise exception 'coupon_exhausted';
  end if;

  if p_subtotal < c.min_order_usd then
    raise exception 'coupon_min_order' using detail = c.min_order_usd::text;
  end if;

  if p_user_id is not null and exists (
    select 1 from public.coupon_redemptions r
    where r.coupon_id = c.id and r.user_id = p_user_id
    group by r.coupon_id having count(*) >= c.per_user_limit
  ) then
    raise exception 'coupon_user_limit';
  end if;

  return case
    when c.kind = 'percent' then round(p_subtotal * c.value / 100, 2)
    else least(c.value, p_subtotal)
  end;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.validate_coupon(p_code text, p_subtotal numeric)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_discount numeric;
begin
  v_discount := private.coupon_discount(p_code, (select auth.uid()), p_subtotal);
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'discount_usd', v_discount);
exception
  when others then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason', sqlerrm);
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.validate_coupon(text, numeric) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- create_order: prices are always recomputed from the catalogue.
-- p_items: [{"variant_id": 1, "qty": 2}, ...]
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.create_order(
  p_items   jsonb,
  p_coupon  text default null,
  p_fields  jsonb default '{}'::jsonb,
  p_email   text default null,
  p_note    text default null
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_user       uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_profile    public.profiles;
  v_item       jsonb;
  v_variant    public.product_variants;
  v_product    public.products;
  v_qty        integer;
  v_stock      integer;
  v_subtotal   numeric(12, 2) := 0;
  v_discount   numeric(12, 2) := 0;
  v_total      numeric(12, 2);
  v_order_id   uuid;
  v_order_no   text;
  v_ttl        integer;
  v_required   jsonb;
  v_missing    text;
  v_has_stock  boolean := false;
begin
  if v_user is null then
    raise exception 'auth_required';
  end if;

  select * into v_profile from public.profiles where id = v_user;
  if v_profile.is_blocked then
    raise exception 'account_blocked';
  end if;

  if p_items is null or jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0 then
    raise exception 'empty_cart';
  end if;

  if jsonb_array_length(p_items) > 20 then
    raise exception 'too_many_lines';
  end if;

  select order_ttl_minutes into v_ttl from public.settings where id;

  v_order_no := private.new_order_no();

  insert into public.orders (
    order_no, user_id, status, contact_email, customer_note, customer_fields, coupon_code, expires_at
  ) values (
    v_order_no, v_user, 'pending', p_email, p_note, coalesce(p_fields, '{}'::jsonb),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_coupon, '')), ''),
    now() + make_interval(mins => v_ttl)
  ) returning id into v_order_id;

  for v_item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
  loop
    v_qty := greatest(coalesce((v_item ->> 'qty')::integer, 1), 1);

    select * into v_variant
      from public.product_variants
     where id = (v_item ->> 'variant_id')::bigint
       and is_active;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'variant_unavailable' using detail = (v_item ->> 'variant_id');
    end if;

    select * into v_product from public.products where id = v_variant.product_id and is_active;
    if not found then
      raise exception 'product_unavailable';
    end if;

    if v_qty < v_variant.min_qty or v_qty > v_variant.max_qty then
      raise exception 'qty_out_of_range' using detail = v_variant.sku;
    end if;

    -- Per-product buyer fields (game id, server, ...)
    if v_product.requires_fields is not null and jsonb_array_length(v_product.requires_fields) > 0 then
      select string_agg(f ->> 'key', ', ')
        into v_missing
        from jsonb_array_elements(v_product.requires_fields) f
       where coalesce(btrim(p_fields ->> (f ->> 'key')), '') = '';

      if v_missing is not null then
        raise exception 'missing_fields' using detail = v_missing;
      end if;
    end if;

    if v_variant.stock_mode = 'stock' then
      select count(*) into v_stock
        from private.stock_items s
       where s.variant_id = v_variant.id and s.status = 'available';

      if v_stock < v_qty then
        raise exception 'out_of_stock' using detail = v_variant.sku;
      end if;
      v_has_stock := true;
    end if;

    v_subtotal := v_subtotal + (v_variant.price_usd * v_qty);

    insert into public.order_items (
      order_id, variant_id, product_name, variant_label,
      unit_price_usd, qty, line_total_usd, unit_cost_usd
    ) values (
      v_order_id, v_variant.id, v_product.name_km, v_variant.label_km,
      v_variant.price_usd, v_qty, v_variant.price_usd * v_qty, v_variant.cost_usd
    );
  end loop;

  v_discount := private.coupon_discount(p_coupon, v_user, v_subtotal);
  v_total := greatest(v_subtotal - v_discount, 0);

  update public.orders
     set subtotal_usd = v_subtotal,
         discount_usd = v_discount,
         total_usd    = v_total
   where id = v_order_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'order_id', v_order_id,
    'order_no', v_order_no,
    'subtotal_usd', v_subtotal,
    'discount_usd', v_discount,
    'total_usd', v_total,
    'expires_in_minutes', v_ttl
  );
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.create_order(jsonb, text, jsonb, text, text) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Delivery: atomic stock pickup, then per-kind handling
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function private.deliver_order(p_order_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_item      record;
  v_picked    integer;
  v_pending   integer;
  v_waiting   integer;
  v_all_done  boolean;
begin
  update public.orders set status = 'delivering' where id = p_order_id and status = 'paid';

  for v_item in
    select oi.id, oi.variant_id, oi.qty, p.kind, oi.product_name
      from public.order_items oi
      join public.product_variants v on v.id = oi.variant_id
      join public.products p on p.id = v.product_id
     where oi.order_id = p_order_id
       and oi.delivery_status = 'pending'
     order by oi.id
  loop
    if v_item.kind = 'instant_stock' then
      -- The one statement that prevents double-selling.
      update private.stock_items s
         set status = 'sold', order_id = p_order_id, sold_at = now()
       where s.id in (
         select id
           from private.stock_items
          where variant_id = v_item.variant_id
            and status = 'available'
          order by created_at
          limit v_item.qty
          for update skip locked
       );

      get diagnostics v_picked = row_count;

      if v_picked = v_item.qty then
        update public.order_items
           set delivery_status = 'delivered', delivered_at = now()
         where id = v_item.id;

        update public.products
           set sold_count = sold_count + v_item.qty
         where id = (select product_id from public.product_variants where id = v_item.variant_id);
      else
        -- Roll back a short pick so nothing is stranded mid-order.
        if v_picked > 0 then
          update private.stock_items
             set status = 'available', order_id = null, sold_at = null
           where order_id = p_order_id
             and variant_id = v_item.variant_id
             and status = 'sold'
             and id in (select id from private.stock_items
                         where order_id = p_order_id and variant_id = v_item.variant_id
                         order by id desc limit v_picked);
        end if;

        update public.order_items
           set delivery_status = 'manual_waiting'
         where id = v_item.id;
      end if;

    elsif v_item.kind = 'manual_setup' then
      update public.order_items
         set delivery_status = 'manual_waiting'
       where id = v_item.id;

    else
      -- auto_topup: a worker calls the supplier API and flips this row.
      update public.order_items
         set delivery_status = 'pending'
       where id = v_item.id;
    end if;
  end loop;

  select
    count(*) filter (where delivery_status = 'pending'),
    count(*) filter (where delivery_status = 'manual_waiting')
    into v_pending, v_waiting
    from public.order_items where order_id = p_order_id;

  v_all_done := (v_pending = 0 and v_waiting = 0);

  update public.orders
     set status = case when v_all_done then 'delivered'::public.order_status else 'delivering'::public.order_status end,
         delivered_at = case when v_all_done then now() else delivered_at end
   where id = p_order_id;
end;
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- mark_order_paid: idempotent. Safe to call from a webhook more than once.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.mark_order_paid(
  p_order_id     uuid,
  p_provider     public.payment_provider,
  p_provider_ref text default null,
  p_payway_method text default null,
  p_raw          jsonb default null,
  p_amount_khr   numeric default null
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_order public.orders;
begin
  select * into v_order from public.orders where id = p_order_id for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'order_not_found';
  end if;

  if v_order.status not in ('pending', 'paid', 'delivering') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'status', v_order.status);
  end if;

  if p_provider_ref is not null then
    insert into public.payments (
      order_id, provider, status, amount_usd, amount_khr,
      provider_ref, payway_method, raw_payload, verified_at
    ) values (
      p_order_id, p_provider, 'succeeded', v_order.total_usd, p_amount_khr,
      p_provider_ref, p_payway_method, p_raw, now()
    )
    on conflict (provider, provider_ref) where provider_ref is not null
    do update set status = 'succeeded', verified_at = now(), raw_payload = excluded.raw_payload;
  end if;

  if v_order.status = 'pending' then
    update public.orders set status = 'paid', paid_at = now() where id = p_order_id;

    if v_order.coupon_code is not null then
      update public.coupons
         set used_count = used_count + 1
       where upper(code) = upper(v_order.coupon_code);

      insert into public.coupon_redemptions (coupon_id, user_id, order_id, amount_usd)
      select c.id, v_order.user_id, p_order_id, v_order.discount_usd
        from public.coupons c
       where upper(c.code) = upper(v_order.coupon_code)
      on conflict do nothing;
    end if;

    perform private.deliver_order(p_order_id);
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'status', 'paid');
end;
$$;

-- Only the service role may settle an order.
revoke execute on function public.mark_order_paid(uuid, public.payment_provider, text, text, jsonb, numeric) from public, anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pay from wallet (debit + settle in one transaction)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.pay_order_with_wallet(p_order_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_user  uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_order public.orders;
  v_bal   numeric(12, 2);
begin
  if v_user is null then raise exception 'auth_required'; end if;

  select * into v_order from public.orders
   where id = p_order_id and user_id = v_user
   for update;

  if not found then raise exception 'order_not_found'; end if;
  if v_order.status <> 'pending' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'status', v_order.status);
  end if;
  if v_order.expires_at < now() then raise exception 'order_expired'; end if;

  select wallet_balance into v_bal from public.profiles where id = v_user for update;
  if v_bal < v_order.total_usd then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason', 'insufficient_balance', 'balance', v_bal, 'required', v_order.total_usd);
  end if;

  perform private.credit_wallet(v_user, -v_order.total_usd, 'purchase', p_order_id, 'order ' || v_order.order_no);

  update public.orders set status = 'paid', paid_at = now() where id = p_order_id;

  insert into public.payments (order_id, provider, status, amount_usd, verified_at)
  values (p_order_id, 'wallet', 'succeeded', v_order.total_usd, now());

  perform private.deliver_order(p_order_id);

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'status', 'paid');
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.pay_order_with_wallet(uuid) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- reveal_order: decrypted credentials for a paid order the caller owns
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.reveal_order(p_order_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_user uuid := (select auth.uid());
begin
  if v_user is null then raise exception 'auth_required'; end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.orders o
    where o.id = p_order_id
      and (o.user_id = v_user or public.is_staff())
      and o.status in ('paid', 'delivering', 'delivered')
  ) then
    raise exception 'not_authorized';
  end if;

  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x ->> 'item_id'), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'item_id', oi.id,
        'product_name', oi.product_name,
        'variant_label', oi.variant_label,
        'qty', oi.qty,
        'delivery_status', oi.delivery_status,
        'payloads', (
          select coalesce(jsonb_agg(private.decrypt_payload(s.payload_enc) order by s.sold_at), '[]'::jsonb)
          from private.stock_items s
          where s.order_id = p_order_id and s.variant_id = oi.variant_id and s.status = 'sold'
        )
      ) as x
      from public.order_items oi
      where oi.order_id = p_order_id
    ) t
  );
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.reveal_order(uuid) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Staff: add stock, resolve manual items, adjust wallet
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.admin_add_stock(p_variant_id bigint, p_payloads text[])
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_count integer := 0;
begin
  if not public.is_staff() then raise exception 'not_authorized'; end if;

  insert into private.stock_items (variant_id, payload_enc)
  select p_variant_id, private.encrypt_payload(p)
    from unnest(p_payloads) p
   where btrim(p) <> '';

  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.admin_add_stock(bigint, text[]) to authenticated;

create or replace function public.admin_resolve_item(
  p_item_id  bigint,
  p_delivery public.delivery_status default 'delivered'
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_order uuid;
begin
  if not public.is_staff() then raise exception 'not_authorized'; end if;

  update public.order_items
     set delivery_status = p_delivery,
         delivered_at = case when p_delivery = 'delivered' then now() else null end
   where id = p_item_id
  returning order_id into v_order;

  if v_order is null then raise exception 'item_not_found'; end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.order_items
    where order_id = v_order and delivery_status <> 'delivered'
  ) then
    update public.orders
       set status = 'delivered', delivered_at = now()
     where id = v_order;
  end if;
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.admin_resolve_item(bigint, public.delivery_status) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Housekeeping: run on a schedule (pg_cron)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.expire_stale_orders()
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_count integer;
begin
  update private.stock_items
     set status = 'available', order_id = null, reserved_at = null
   where status = 'reserved'
     and reserved_at < now() - interval '30 minutes';

  with expired as (
    update public.orders
       set status = 'expired'
     where status = 'pending' and expires_at < now()
    returning id
  ),
  voided as (
    update public.payments p
       set status = 'expired'
      from expired e
     where p.order_id = e.id and p.status in ('initiated', 'pending')
    returning p.id
  )
  select count(*) into v_count from expired;

  return v_count;
end;
$$;

create or replace function public.refresh_product_ratings()
returns void
language sql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  update public.products p
     set rating_avg = coalesce(r.avg_rating, 0),
         rating_count = coalesce(r.cnt, 0)
    from (
      select product_id, round(avg(rating)::numeric, 2) as avg_rating, count(*) as cnt
        from public.reviews
       where is_approved
       group by product_id
    ) r
   where p.id = r.product_id;
$$;


-- ============================================================================
-- 20261015000400_wallet_cron_admin.sql
-- ============================================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- Closes the gaps found in the first audit:
--   1. wallet had no way to be funded
--   2. expire_stale_orders() and refresh_product_ratings() were never scheduled
--   3. reviews could never be approved, so ratings stayed at zero
--   4. auto_topup items had no worker to fulfil them
-- ============================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Wallet top-up
--
-- A top-up reuses the whole order/payment pipeline: create a pending order with
-- kind='wallet_topup', pay it by KHQR, and mark_order_paid credits the wallet
-- instead of delivering goods.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.orders
  add column if not exists kind text not null default 'purchase'
  check (kind in ('purchase', 'wallet_topup'));

create index if not exists orders_kind_idx on public.orders (kind) where kind = 'wallet_topup';

alter table public.settings
  add column if not exists topup_min_usd numeric(12, 2) not null default 1,
  add column if not exists topup_max_usd numeric(12, 2) not null default 1000;

create or replace view public.public_settings as
select
  id,
  site_name,
  support_telegram,
  support_email,
  usd_to_khr,
  order_ttl_minutes,
  khqr_account_id,
  khqr_merchant_name,
  khqr_merchant_city,
  is_maintenance,
  topup_min_usd,
  topup_max_usd
from public.settings;

grant select on public.public_settings to anon, authenticated;

create or replace function public.create_wallet_topup(
  p_amount_usd numeric,
  p_email      text default null
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_user     uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_profile  public.profiles;
  v_settings public.settings;
  v_order_id uuid;
  v_order_no text;
begin
  if v_user is null then
    raise exception 'auth_required';
  end if;

  select * into v_profile from public.profiles where id = v_user;
  if v_profile.is_blocked then
    raise exception 'account_blocked';
  end if;

  select * into v_settings from public.settings where id;

  -- Round to cents so the KHQR amount always matches what PayWay is told.
  p_amount_usd := round(coalesce(p_amount_usd, 0), 2);

  if p_amount_usd < v_settings.topup_min_usd then
    raise exception 'topup_below_minimum'
      using detail = v_settings.topup_min_usd::text;
  end if;

  if p_amount_usd > v_settings.topup_max_usd then
    raise exception 'topup_above_maximum'
      using detail = v_settings.topup_max_usd::text;
  end if;

  v_order_no := private.new_order_no();

  insert into public.orders (
    order_no, user_id, status, kind, contact_email,
    subtotal_usd, discount_usd, total_usd, expires_at
  ) values (
    v_order_no, v_user, 'pending', 'wallet_topup', p_email,
    p_amount_usd, 0, p_amount_usd,
    now() + make_interval(mins => v_settings.order_ttl_minutes)
  ) returning id into v_order_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'order_id', v_order_id,
    'order_no', v_order_no,
    'total_usd', p_amount_usd,
    'expires_in_minutes', v_settings.order_ttl_minutes
  );
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.create_wallet_topup(numeric, text) to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- mark_order_paid: credit top-ups instead of delivering goods
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.mark_order_paid(
  p_order_id      uuid,
  p_provider      public.payment_provider,
  p_provider_ref  text default null,
  p_payway_method text default null,
  p_raw           jsonb default null,
  p_amount_khr    numeric default null
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_order public.orders;
  v_bal   numeric(12, 2);
begin
  select * into v_order from public.orders where id = p_order_id for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'order_not_found';
  end if;

  if v_order.status not in ('pending', 'paid', 'delivering', 'delivered') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'status', v_order.status);
  end if;

  if p_provider_ref is not null then
    insert into public.payments (
      order_id, provider, status, amount_usd, amount_khr,
      provider_ref, payway_method, raw_payload, verified_at
    ) values (
      p_order_id, p_provider, 'succeeded', v_order.total_usd, p_amount_khr,
      p_provider_ref, p_payway_method, p_raw, now()
    )
    on conflict (provider, provider_ref) where provider_ref is not null
    do update set status = 'succeeded', verified_at = now(), raw_payload = excluded.raw_payload;
  end if;

  -- Idempotency: only the transition out of 'pending' moves money or stock.
  if v_order.status = 'pending' then
    update public.orders set status = 'paid', paid_at = now() where id = p_order_id;

    if v_order.coupon_code is not null then
      update public.coupons
         set used_count = used_count + 1
       where upper(code) = upper(v_order.coupon_code);

      insert into public.coupon_redemptions (coupon_id, user_id, order_id, amount_usd)
      select c.id, v_order.user_id, p_order_id, v_order.discount_usd
        from public.coupons c
       where upper(c.code) = upper(v_order.coupon_code)
      on conflict do nothing;
    end if;

    if v_order.kind = 'wallet_topup' then
      v_bal := private.credit_wallet(
        v_order.user_id, v_order.total_usd, 'topup', p_order_id,
        'topup ' || v_order.order_no
      );

      update public.orders
         set status = 'delivered', delivered_at = now()
       where id = p_order_id;

      return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'status', 'delivered', 'wallet_balance', v_bal);
    end if;

    perform private.deliver_order(p_order_id);
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'status', 'paid');
end;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.mark_order_paid(uuid, public.payment_provider, text, text, jsonb, numeric)
  from public, anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2 + 3. Review approval, and ratings that actually move
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.admin_review_set_approved(
  p_review_id bigint,
  p_approved  boolean,
  p_reward_coins integer default 5
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_review public.reviews;
begin
  if not public.is_staff() then
    raise exception 'not_authorized';
  end if;

  update public.reviews
     set is_approved = p_approved
   where id = p_review_id
  returning * into v_review;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'review_not_found';
  end if;

  -- Pay the review reward once, and only for an approval.
  if p_approved and not v_review.coin_rewarded and p_reward_coins > 0 then
    update public.profiles
       set coins = coins + p_reward_coins
     where id = v_review.user_id;

    update public.reviews set coin_rewarded = true where id = p_review_id;
  end if;

  perform public.refresh_product_ratings();
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.admin_review_set_approved(bigint, boolean, integer) to authenticated;

-- Rating drift is otherwise silent, so keep it refresher-driven.
create or replace function public.refresh_all_product_ratings()
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_count integer;
begin
  update public.products p
     set rating_avg = coalesce(r.avg_rating, 0),
         rating_count = coalesce(r.cnt, 0)
    from (
      select product_id,
             round(avg(rating)::numeric, 2) as avg_rating,
             count(*)                        as cnt
        from public.reviews
       where is_approved
       group by product_id
    ) r
   where p.id = r.product_id;

  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;

  -- Products whose last review was unapproved keep a stale average; zero them.
  update public.products p
     set rating_avg = 0, rating_count = 0
   where not exists (
     select 1 from public.reviews rv
      where rv.product_id = p.id and rv.is_approved
   )
     and (p.rating_avg <> 0 or p.rating_count <> 0);

  return v_count;
end;
$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Supplier worker: hand out auto_topup lines and take them back
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.supplier_pending_items(p_limit integer default 20)
returns table (
  item_id        bigint,
  order_id       uuid,
  order_no       text,
  variant_id     bigint,
  sku            text,
  qty            integer,
  customer_fields jsonb,
  supplier_code  text,
  supplier_sku   text,
  cost_usd       numeric
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select
    oi.id,
    o.id,
    o.order_no,
    v.id,
    v.sku,
    oi.qty,
    o.customer_fields,
    s.code,
    ss.supplier_sku,
    coalesce(ss.cost_usd, v.cost_usd)
  from public.order_items oi
  join public.orders o on o.id = oi.order_id
  join public.product_variants v on v.id = oi.variant_id
  join public.products p on p.id = v.product_id
  left join public.supplier_skus ss on ss.variant_id = v.id and ss.is_active
  left join public.suppliers s on s.id = ss.supplier_id and s.is_active
 where oi.delivery_status = 'pending'
   and p.kind = 'auto_topup'
   and o.status in ('paid', 'delivering')
 order by oi.id
 limit p_limit;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.supplier_pending_items(integer) from public, anon, authenticated;

create or replace function public.supplier_complete_item(
  p_item_id   bigint,
  p_success   boolean,
  p_supplier_ref text default null,
  p_cost_usd  numeric default null
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_item    public.order_items;
  v_order   public.orders;
  v_pending integer;
  v_failed  integer;
begin
  select * into v_item from public.order_items where id = p_item_id for update;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'item_not_found';
  end if;

  select * into v_order from public.orders where id = v_item.order_id for update;

  if p_success then
    update public.order_items
       set delivery_status = 'delivered',
           delivered_at = now(),
           supplier_ref = coalesce(p_supplier_ref, supplier_ref),
           unit_cost_usd = coalesce(p_cost_usd, unit_cost_usd)
     where id = p_item_id;

    update public.products
       set sold_count = sold_count + v_item.qty
     where id = (select product_id from public.product_variants where id = v_item.variant_id);
  else
    update public.order_items
       set delivery_status = 'failed',
           supplier_ref = coalesce(p_supplier_ref, supplier_ref)
     where id = p_item_id;

    -- The buyer paid for something we cannot deliver, so return it to their
    -- wallet rather than leaving them to open a support ticket.
    perform private.credit_wallet(
      v_order.user_id, v_item.line_total_usd, 'refund', v_order.id,
      'refund ' || v_order.order_no || ' (' || v_item.product_name || ')'
    );
  end if;

  select
    count(*) filter (where delivery_status = 'pending'),
    count(*) filter (where delivery_status = 'failed')
    into v_pending, v_failed
    from public.order_items where order_id = v_order.id;

  if v_pending = 0 then
    update public.orders
       set status = case
                      when v_failed > 0 then 'failed'::public.order_status
                      else 'delivered'::public.order_status
                    end,
           delivered_at = case when v_failed = 0 then now() else delivered_at end
     where id = v_order.id;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'order_status', (select status from public.orders where id = v_order.id),
    'refunded_usd', case when p_success then 0 else v_item.line_total_usd end
  );
end;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.supplier_complete_item(bigint, boolean, text, numeric)
  from public, anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2 (cont). Schedule the housekeeping that was never running
--
-- pg_cron is present on hosted Supabase and absent from a plain Postgres
-- container, so this degrades instead of failing the migration.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_namespace where nspname = 'cron') then
    if exists (select 1 from pg_available_extensions where name = 'pg_cron') then
      execute 'create extension pg_cron';
    end if;
  end if;

  if exists (select 1 from pg_namespace where nspname = 'cron') then
    execute $sql$delete from cron.job where jobname in ('ycp-expire-orders', 'ycp-refresh-ratings')$sql$;
    execute $sql$select cron.schedule('ycp-expire-orders', '*/2 * * * *', 'select public.expire_stale_orders()')$sql$;
    execute $sql$select cron.schedule('ycp-refresh-ratings', '*/30 * * * *', 'select public.refresh_all_product_ratings()')$sql$;
    raise notice 'pg_cron jobs scheduled';
  else
    raise notice 'pg_cron unavailable (local container) - schedule these on the host instead';
  end if;
end $$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Housekeeping: also void expired top-ups, and expose the sweep to staff
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.admin_run_housekeeping()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_expired integer;
begin
  if not public.is_staff() then
    raise exception 'not_authorized';
  end if;

  v_expired := public.expire_stale_orders();
  perform public.refresh_all_product_ratings();

  return jsonb_build_object('expired_orders', v_expired);
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.admin_run_housekeeping() to authenticated;


-- ============================================================================
-- 20261015000500_telegram.sql
-- ============================================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- Telegram: account linking, and an outbox so notifications are durable.
--
-- Why an outbox rather than sending directly: an instant order is delivered
-- inside mark_order_paid, but a manual or supplier order is delivered minutes
-- or hours later by a different actor. Writing the message to a table means the
-- notification cannot be lost if the sender is not around at that moment.
-- ============================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Settings the bot needs
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.settings
  add column if not exists telegram_bot_username text,
  add column if not exists support_telegram_chat_id bigint;

create or replace view public.public_settings as
select
  id, site_name, support_telegram, support_email, usd_to_khr, order_ttl_minutes,
  khqr_account_id, khqr_merchant_name, khqr_merchant_city, is_maintenance,
  topup_min_usd, topup_max_usd, telegram_bot_username
from public.settings;

grant select on public.public_settings to anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Linking
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.profiles
  add column if not exists telegram_chat_id bigint,
  add column if not exists telegram_username text,
  add column if not exists telegram_linked_at timestamptz;

create unique index if not exists profiles_telegram_chat_idx
  on public.profiles (telegram_chat_id) where telegram_chat_id is not null;

create table if not exists public.telegram_link_codes (
  code       text primary key,
  user_id    uuid not null references public.profiles (id) on delete cascade,
  expires_at timestamptz not null default (now() + interval '15 minutes'),
  used_at    timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

alter table public.telegram_link_codes enable row level security;
-- No policies and no grants: reached only through the functions below.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Outbox
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.notifications (
  id         bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  user_id    uuid references public.profiles (id) on delete cascade,
  chat_id    bigint,
  kind       text not null,
  payload    jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  status     text not null default 'pending'
             check (status in ('pending', 'sending', 'sent', 'failed', 'skipped')),
  attempts   integer not null default 0,
  last_error text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  sent_at    timestamptz
);

alter table public.notifications enable row level security;

create index if not exists notifications_pending_idx
  on public.notifications (created_at) where status = 'pending';

create index if not exists notifications_user_idx
  on public.notifications (user_id, created_at desc);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Enqueue on terminal order states.
--
-- Deliberately only 'delivered' and 'failed': notifying on 'paid' would fire a
-- second message milliseconds later for instant orders, and 'delivering' means
-- nothing to the buyer yet.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function private.enqueue_order_notification()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_chat bigint;
begin
  if new.status = old.status then
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.status not in ('delivered', 'failed') then
    return new;
  end if;

  select p.telegram_chat_id into v_chat
    from public.profiles p where p.id = new.user_id;

  insert into public.notifications (user_id, chat_id, kind, payload)
  values (
    new.user_id,
    v_chat,
    case new.status
      when 'delivered' then 'order_delivered'
      else 'order_failed'
    end,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'order_id', new.id,
      'order_no', new.order_no,
      'total_usd', new.total_usd,
      'kind', new.kind
    )
  );

  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists orders_notify on public.orders;
create trigger orders_notify
  after update on public.orders
  for each row execute function private.enqueue_order_notification();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- create_telegram_link_code: the app shows a code, the buyer sends it to the bot
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.create_telegram_link_code()
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_user   uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_code   text;
  v_bot    text;
begin
  if v_user is null then
    raise exception 'auth_required';
  end if;

  -- One live code per user.
  delete from public.telegram_link_codes
   where user_id = v_user and used_at is null;

  v_code := upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 6));

  insert into public.telegram_link_codes (code, user_id) values (v_code, v_user);

  select telegram_bot_username into v_bot from public.settings where id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'code', v_code,
    'expires_in_minutes', 15,
    'bot_username', v_bot,
    'deep_link', case
      when v_bot is null then null
      else 'https://t.me/' || v_bot || '?start=' || v_code
    end
  );
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.create_telegram_link_code() to authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- link_telegram: called by the webhook after /start <code>
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.link_telegram(
  p_code     text,
  p_chat_id  bigint,
  p_username text default null
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_row public.telegram_link_codes;
begin
  select * into v_row
    from public.telegram_link_codes
   where code = upper(btrim(p_code))
     and used_at is null
   for update;

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason', 'code_invalid');
  end if;

  if v_row.expires_at < now() then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason', 'code_expired');
  end if;

  -- A Telegram account belongs to one profile at a time.
  update public.profiles
     set telegram_chat_id = null, telegram_username = null, telegram_linked_at = null
   where telegram_chat_id = p_chat_id and id <> v_row.user_id;

  update public.profiles
     set telegram_chat_id = p_chat_id,
         telegram_username = p_username,
         telegram_linked_at = now()
   where id = v_row.user_id;

  update public.telegram_link_codes set used_at = now() where code = v_row.code;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'user_id', v_row.user_id);
end;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.link_telegram(text, bigint, text)
  from public, anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Outbox claim / ack, used by the dispatcher
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.telegram_claim_notifications(p_limit integer default 20)
returns table (
  notification_id bigint,
  chat_id         bigint,
  kind            text,
  payload         jsonb
)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  -- Resolve the chat at send time rather than at enqueue time. A buyer who
  -- links their account after an order was delivered still gets the message.
  update public.notifications n
     set chat_id = p.telegram_chat_id
    from public.profiles p
   where n.user_id = p.id
     and n.status = 'pending'
     and n.chat_id is null
     and p.telegram_chat_id is not null;

  -- Give an unlinked buyer a day to link before writing the message off.
  -- Notifications stay in the app either way.
  update public.notifications n
     set status = 'skipped', last_error = 'no_telegram_account'
   where n.status = 'pending'
     and n.chat_id is null
     and n.created_at < now() - interval '24 hours';

  -- Anything stuck in 'sending' means a dispatcher died mid-flight.
  update public.notifications n
     set status = 'pending', last_error = 'requeued_after_timeout'
   where n.status = 'sending' and n.attempts < 5;

  return query
  with claimed as (
    select n2.id
      from public.notifications n2
     where n2.status = 'pending'
       and n2.chat_id is not null
       and n2.attempts < 5
     order by n2.created_at
     limit p_limit
     for update skip locked
  )
  update public.notifications n3
     set status = 'sending', attempts = n3.attempts + 1
    from claimed c
   where n3.id = c.id
  returning n3.id, n3.chat_id, n3.kind, n3.payload;
end;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.telegram_claim_notifications(integer)
  from public, anon, authenticated;

create or replace function public.telegram_ack_notification(
  p_id     bigint,
  p_ok     boolean,
  p_error  text default null
)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  update public.notifications
     set status = case
                    when p_ok then 'sent'
                    when attempts >= 5 then 'failed'
                    else 'pending'
                  end,
         last_error = p_error,
         sent_at = case when p_ok then now() else sent_at end
   where id = p_id;
end;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.telegram_ack_notification(bigint, boolean, text)
  from public, anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- What the bot is allowed to read back to a chat
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.telegram_orders_for_chat(
  p_chat_id bigint,
  p_limit   integer default 5
)
returns jsonb
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'order_no', o.order_no,
      'status', o.status,
      'total_usd', o.total_usd,
      'created_at', o.created_at,
      'items', (
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(oi.product_name || ' x' || oi.qty), '[]'::jsonb)
          from public.order_items oi where oi.order_id = o.id
      )
    ) as x
    from public.orders o
    join public.profiles p on p.id = o.user_id
   where p.telegram_chat_id = p_chat_id
   order by o.created_at desc
   limit p_limit
  ) t;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.telegram_orders_for_chat(bigint, integer)
  from public, anon, authenticated;

create or replace function public.telegram_order_by_no(
  p_chat_id  bigint,
  p_order_no text
)
returns jsonb
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'order_no', o.order_no,
    'status', o.status,
    'total_usd', o.total_usd,
    'created_at', o.created_at,
    'items', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'name', oi.product_name,
        'qty', oi.qty,
        'delivery_status', oi.delivery_status,
        'codes', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(private.decrypt_payload(s.payload_enc) order by s.sold_at)
            from private.stock_items s
           where s.order_id = o.id and s.variant_id = oi.variant_id and s.status = 'sold'
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
      )), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.order_items oi where oi.order_id = o.id
    )
  )
  from public.orders o
  join public.profiles p on p.id = o.user_id
 where p.telegram_chat_id = p_chat_id
   and upper(o.order_no) = upper(btrim(p_order_no))
   and o.status in ('paid', 'delivering', 'delivered')
  limit 1;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.telegram_order_by_no(bigint, text)
  from public, anon, authenticated;

create or replace function public.telegram_profile_for_chat(p_chat_id bigint)
returns jsonb
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'user_id', p.id,
    'display_name', p.display_name,
    'wallet_balance', p.wallet_balance,
    'coins', p.coins,
    'linked_at', p.telegram_linked_at
  )
  from public.profiles p
  where p.telegram_chat_id = p_chat_id
  limit 1;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.telegram_profile_for_chat(bigint)
  from public, anon, authenticated;

create or replace function public.telegram_unlink(p_chat_id bigint)
returns boolean
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_count integer;
begin
  update public.profiles
     set telegram_chat_id = null, telegram_username = null, telegram_linked_at = null
   where telegram_chat_id = p_chat_id;

  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count > 0;
end;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.telegram_unlink(bigint)
  from public, anon, authenticated;


-- ============================================================================
-- 20261015000600_suppliers.sql
-- ============================================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- Supplier integration: make sync and fulfilment idempotent, and let a line
-- defer (retry) instead of being refunded when the failure is ours, not the
-- buyer's.
--
-- The distinction matters: "insufficient supplier balance" must not refund a
-- buyer who paid correctly, and must not silently drop the order either.
-- ============================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Products owned by a supplier sync
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.products
  add column if not exists supplier_id bigint references public.suppliers (id) on delete set null,
  add column if not exists supplier_game_code text;

create unique index if not exists products_supplier_game_idx
  on public.products (supplier_id, supplier_game_code)
  where supplier_id is not null and supplier_game_code is not null;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Attempt tracking on the job row
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.order_items
  add column if not exists supplier_attempts integer not null default 0,
  add column if not exists supplier_last_error text,
  add column if not exists supplier_next_attempt_at timestamptz;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Known suppliers. is_active stays false until a key exists.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
insert into public.suppliers (code, name, base_url, is_active) values
  ('bay2game', 'Bay2Game', 'https://api.bay2game.xyz/api', false),
  ('kasplay',  'KAS Play', 'https://reseller-api.kasplay.kascambodia.com/api/v1', false)
on conflict (code) do nothing;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- supplier_pending_items: skip lines that are backing off or exhausted, and
-- hand the worker everything it needs including attempt count.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
drop function if exists public.supplier_pending_items(integer);

create or replace function public.supplier_pending_items(p_limit integer default 20)
returns table (
  item_id         bigint,
  order_id        uuid,
  order_no        text,
  variant_id      bigint,
  sku             text,
  qty             integer,
  customer_fields jsonb,
  supplier_code   text,
  supplier_sku    text,
  cost_usd        numeric,
  attempts        integer
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select
    oi.id,
    o.id,
    o.order_no,
    v.id,
    v.sku,
    oi.qty,
    o.customer_fields,
    s.code,
    ss.supplier_sku,
    coalesce(ss.cost_usd, v.cost_usd),
    oi.supplier_attempts
  from public.order_items oi
  join public.orders o on o.id = oi.order_id
  join public.product_variants v on v.id = oi.variant_id
  join public.products p on p.id = v.product_id
  left join public.supplier_skus ss on ss.variant_id = v.id and ss.is_active
  left join public.suppliers s on s.id = ss.supplier_id and s.is_active
 where oi.delivery_status = 'pending'
   and p.kind = 'auto_topup'
   and o.status in ('paid', 'delivering')
   and oi.supplier_attempts < 5
   and (oi.supplier_next_attempt_at is null or oi.supplier_next_attempt_at <= now())
 order by oi.id
 limit p_limit;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.supplier_pending_items(integer)
  from public, anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- supplier_note_failure: record an attempt without moving money.
-- Used when the failure is transient or the supplier account is at fault
-- (out of balance, upstream 500). The line stays pending and retries.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.supplier_note_failure(
  p_item_id bigint,
  p_error   text,
  p_retry_in_minutes integer default 10
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare v_attempts integer;
begin
  update public.order_items
     set supplier_attempts = supplier_attempts + 1,
         supplier_last_error = left(p_error, 500),
         supplier_next_attempt_at = now() + make_interval(mins => p_retry_in_minutes)
   where id = p_item_id
  returning supplier_attempts into v_attempts;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'item_not_found';
  end if;

  -- Out of retries: this is now a staff problem, so leave a marker rather than
  -- refunding a buyer whose order was never actually attempted.
  if v_attempts >= 5 then
    update public.order_items
       set delivery_status = 'manual_waiting'
     where id = p_item_id;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'attempts', v_attempts);
end;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.supplier_note_failure(bigint, text, integer)
  from public, anon, authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- supplier_upsert_catalogue: one call per game, so a sync is atomic per game
-- and cannot leave a half-linked product behind.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.supplier_upsert_catalogue(
  p_supplier_code text,
  p_game_code     text,
  p_name          text,
  p_image_url     text,
  p_summary       text,
  p_required_fields jsonb,      -- ["userid","serverid"]
  p_products      jsonb         -- [{ product_code, name, price_usd }]
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_supplier public.suppliers;
  v_product_id bigint;
  v_slug text;
  v_item jsonb;
  v_variant_id bigint;
  v_upserted integer := 0;
begin
  select * into v_supplier from public.suppliers where code = p_supplier_code;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'unknown_supplier' using detail = p_supplier_code;
  end if;

  v_slug := p_supplier_code || '-' || p_game_code;

  insert into public.products (
    slug, name_km, name_en, summary_km, summary_en, image_url, kind,
    requires_fields, supplier_id, supplier_game_code, is_active, sort_order
  ) values (
    v_slug, p_name, p_name, p_summary, p_summary, p_image_url, 'auto_topup',
    coalesce(p_required_fields, '[]'::jsonb), v_supplier.id, p_game_code, true, 1000
  )
  on conflict (slug) do update
    set name_km       = excluded.name_km,
        name_en       = excluded.name_en,
        summary_km    = excluded.summary_km,
        summary_en    = excluded.summary_en,
        image_url     = coalesce(excluded.image_url, public.products.image_url),
        requires_fields = excluded.requires_fields,
        supplier_id   = excluded.supplier_id,
        supplier_game_code = excluded.supplier_game_code,
        updated_at    = now()
  returning id into v_product_id;

  for v_item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_products)
  loop
    insert into public.product_variants (
      product_id, sku, label_km, label_en, price_usd, cost_usd,
      stock_mode, min_qty, max_qty, is_active, sort_order
    ) values (
      v_product_id,
      (v_item ->> 'product_code'),
      (v_item ->> 'name'),
      (v_item ->> 'name'),
      -- The supplier price is cost. Retail is set by staff afterwards; until
      -- then it is cost, so an unpriced SKU can never be sold at a loss.
      round((v_item ->> 'price_usd')::numeric, 2),
      round((v_item ->> 'price_usd')::numeric, 2),
      'unlimited', 1, 50, true, coalesce((v_item ->> 'sort')::int, 0)
    )
    on conflict (sku) do update
      set label_km  = excluded.label_km,
          label_en  = excluded.label_en,
          cost_usd  = excluded.cost_usd,
          is_active = true,
          product_id = excluded.product_id
    returning id into v_variant_id;

    insert into public.supplier_skus (
      supplier_id, variant_id, supplier_sku, cost_usd, is_active, last_synced_at, last_cost_usd
    ) values (
      v_supplier.id, v_variant_id, (v_item ->> 'product_code'),
      round((v_item ->> 'price_usd')::numeric, 2), true, now(),
      round((v_item ->> 'price_usd')::numeric, 2)
    )
    on conflict (supplier_id, variant_id, supplier_sku) do update
      set cost_usd       = excluded.cost_usd,
          last_cost_usd  = excluded.last_cost_usd,
          last_synced_at = now(),
          is_active      = true;

    v_upserted := v_upserted + 1;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'product_id', v_product_id,
    'slug', v_slug,
    'variants_synced', v_upserted
  );
end;
$$;

revoke execute on function public.supplier_upsert_catalogue(text, text, text, text, text, jsonb, jsonb)
  from public, anon, authenticated;
